Name: Wall Televisions - Continued
Author: FlyingTNT
Description:
This is a continuation of aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11448]Wall Televisions[/url]

This mod lets you place the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Plasma_TV]Plasma TV[/url] and the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Tropical_TV]Tropical TV[/url] on walls.

TVs can be placed on the bottom tile of any wall that accepts wallpaper.

TVs are displayed without a stand when placed on a wall tile.

The TV sprites can be changed using Content Patcher by targeting the following path:

aedenthorn.WallTelevision/tv

This path is for both televisions, check the png in the mod's assets folder for layout.


[size=5]Technical[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Source code: [url=https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods[/url].
